title: THE HOOK
beats: Every great product begins with a real human need. Yet the people who use them rarely get a voice before manufacturing starts.

title: GENESIS REVEAL
beats: Introducing PayPal GENESIS—a consumer-led innovation platform uniting real demand, structured intelligence, and instant Judge Demo access.

title: CONSUMER IDEA CREATION
beats: Inside the Consumer Creation Studio, anyone can pitch a product they wish existed—capturing target audience, budget, and real-world pain points in four guided steps.

title: GENESIS INTELLIGENCE
beats: GENESIS Intelligence converts raw consumer ideas into structured, editable engineering specifications—persisted in Cloudflare D1 for immediate manufacturer evaluation.

title: COMMUNITY DEMAND
beats: Community members signal purchase intent and report real-world product issues, proving genuine customer demand before a single unit enters production.

title: AG STUDIO INTELLIGENCE
beats: In the Command Center powered by AG Grid and AG Studio, manufacturers sort, cross-filter, and inspect live demand—combining custom Opportunity Spotlight widgets, Intelligence Briefs, and instant CSV export.

title: MANUFACTURER ACTION
beats: Manufacturers review technical requirements, publish batch production offers with transparent pricing, and coordinate milestones from prototype to launch.

title: PAYPAL SANDBOX CHECKOUT
beats: When an offer goes live, PayPal Orders API v2 drives server-verified Sandbox checkout, idempotent payment capture, and signed webhook reconciliation.

title: THE COMPLETE JOURNEY
beats: From idea to intelligence, demand, manufacturing, and PayPal checkout—one open-source platform.

title: GENESIS END CARD
beats: PayPal GENESIS. Products should begin with people.
